generatedFrom: 2026-10-27 sidebar sort/status increment: painted list delegates to the Orca comparator (smart/name/recent/project/manual), reads persisted manual order and activity, and routes lanes by persisted workspace status with the store's definitions

rows.note: Painted Agent Activity order uses Orca's classes (1 blocked/waiting, 2 fresh done, 3 working, 4 live-idle, 5 idle) and the freshest-event tie-break.
Recent mode uses effectiveRecentActivity (createdAt + 5min create-grace floor bounded by now) through the shared comparator.
Name mode uses getWorktreeSortLabel (trimmed displayName, else path basename, else id) keyed per row object.
Menu offers Agent Activity/Name/Recent/Project/Manual and each maps onto the shared comparator; manual uses manualOrder with sortOrder fallback.
Lanes read the persisted workspaceStatus and the store's definitions; agent activity no longer overwrites the lane, and the lane header keeps label/tone/icon/count.
Sort epochs are routed through createSortSettleGate (3s); epoch bumps on manual reorders and meaningful status changes, structural changes bypass the window.
Project order is now a real Manual/Recent choice; repoOrder comes from the visible repo order and the anchor picks the lowest-ranked repo in a multi-host group.
Hookless attention gets the title heuristic (permission class 1, working class 3) with cause.
Cold-start gate: no live PTY and no fresh attributed status.
Painted smart sort falls back to persisted sortOrder during cold start.

Implemented and wired in the mounted sidebar: resize live width, agents-body state, portaled/lazy dialogs, OS folder drop→wizard, granular review inputs, collapsed-group expansion, host scope/rows/selection, reveal, empty gate, pending-creation rows, pointer header drag for repo/group/host tiers, 6px status commit fallback, folder-row aria/indent and multi-host labels.
